examples.en: Someone leaked the confidential report to the press.
examples.zh: 有人把机密报告泄露给了媒体。

examples.en: Engineers located a leak in the gas pipeline within hours.
examples.zh: 工程师数小时内就找到了天然气管道的漏点。

words.usage: 高频语义「泄密」：leak information/news to…；a leak in the roof（屋顶漏雨）；spring a leak（出现裂口）。派生：leakage n. 泄漏（量）
collocations: a leak in the pipe 管道漏点
leak to the press 向媒体泄露
words.mnemonic: l+weak（弱）→管壁一弱就漏→漏、泄

examples.en: The government promised to rein in public spending.
examples.zh: 政府承诺严控公共开支。

examples.en: Managers were given free rein to reorganize their teams.
examples.zh: 经理们获准放手重组各自的团队。

words.usage: 高频短语 rein in（约束、控制）、give free rein to（放任）、keep a tight rein on（严管）；源自勒马之缰。与同音 reign、rain 辨形。
collocations: rein in spending 控制开支
give free rein to 放任
a tight rein 严格的控制
words.mnemonic: 缰绳勒马→控制；rain 雨、reign 王政同音

examples.en: In many cultures, wasting food is regarded as a sin.
examples.zh: 在许多文化中，浪费粮食被视为罪过。

examples.en: Lying to your customers is one of the cardinal sins of business.
examples.zh: 对顾客撒谎是生意场上的一大忌。

words.usage: 宗教道德色彩浓：commit a sin（犯罪孽）、the seven deadly sins（七宗罪）、a cardinal sin（大忌）；与 crime（法律罪行）辨析。派生：sinner n. 罪人
collocations: the seven deadly sins 七宗罪
words.mnemonic: 谐音「辛」：受苦受难因罪起→罪孽

examples.en: The central bank raised interest rates to curb inflation.
examples.zh: 央行为遏制通货膨胀上调了利率。

examples.en: Workers' wages failed to keep pace with inflation last year.
examples.zh: 去年工人工资未能跟上通胀步伐。

words.usage: 经济高频：the inflation rate（通胀率）、curb inflation（控通胀）、runaway inflation（失控通胀）；反义 deflation（通缩）。动词 inflate。
collocations: the inflation rate 通货膨胀率
words.mnemonic: in+flat（吹）+ion→往里吹气→膨胀→通胀

examples.en: Several patients were infected with the virus through contaminated equipment.
examples.zh: 几名患者经污染的器械感染了病毒。

examples.en: His optimism infected everyone around him.
examples.zh: 他的乐观感染了身边每一个人。

words.usage: 结构 infect sb/sth with sth；被动 be infected with（感染上）高频；比喻义「感染情绪」。派生：infection n. 感染；infectious adj. 传染的
collocations: infect sb with enthusiasm 以热情感染某人
infected wounds 受感染的伤口
words.mnemonic: in（进）+fect（做）→病菌进来作祟→感染

words.definition: n. 类似物；adj. 模拟的

examples.en: Steam power has no real analogue in modern technology.
examples.zh: 蒸汽动力在现代技术中没有真正类似的对应物。

examples.en: The museum keeps a working analogue clock from the 1930s.
examples.zh: 博物馆保存着一座二十世纪三十年代仍在走动的指针式时钟。

words.usage: 美式拼作 analog；科技语境 analogue technology/clock（模拟技术/指针钟）与 digital（数字的）对立；an analogue of（…的类似物）。
words.mnemonic: ana（按比例）+logue→按比例相似→类似物

words.definition: adj. 直立的；正直的；adv. 笔直地

examples.en: Sit upright with your back straight to protect your spine.
examples.zh: 坐直并挺直后背，以保护脊柱。

examples.en: He was respected as an upright judge who could not be bribed.
examples.zh: 他作为一位不受贿赂的正直法官而受人尊敬。

words.usage: 姿态义 stand upright（站直）；品德义 an upright citizen（正直的公民）；an upright piano 指立式钢琴。近义 vertical 偏几何概念。
collocations: an upright citizen 正直的公民
an upright piano 立式钢琴
words.mnemonic: up（向上）+right（正）→身正且直→正直的

examples.en: The elderly are particularly vulnerable to pneumonia in winter.
examples.zh: 老年人冬季尤其容易患肺炎。

examples.en: He was hospitalized with double pneumonia last month.
examples.zh: 上个月他因双侧肺炎住院。

words.usage: 搭配 catch/develop pneumonia（患肺炎）；bacterial/viral pneumonia（细菌性/病毒性肺炎）；词首 p 不发音。派生：pneumonic adj. 肺炎的
words.mnemonic: pneumon（肺）+ia（症）→肺上之症；p 不发音

words.definition: v. 弯曲；使屈从；n. 弯道

examples.en: Slow down when you approach a sharp bend on the mountain road.
examples.zh: 山路接近急弯时要减速。

examples.en: The manager refused to bend the rules even for a regular customer.
examples.zh: 经理拒绝通融规则，即使对老顾客也不例外。

words.usage: 不规则动词 bend–bent–bent；高频习语 bend the rules（变通）、bend over backwards（竭尽全力）、bend one's knee（屈膝臣服）。
collocations: bend the rules 变通规则
bend over backwards 竭尽全力
words.mnemonic: b+end（端）→把端头压弯→弯曲；元音族 band/bend/bond

words.definition: n. 誓约；vt. 保证，许诺

examples.en: The government pledged to cut carbon emissions by half within a decade.
examples.zh: 政府承诺十年内将碳排放减半。

examples.en: He made a firm pledge to support the charity every year.
examples.zh: 他郑重承诺每年支持该慈善机构。

words.usage: 高频结构 pledge to do sth（保证做…）、make a pledge（作出承诺）、pledge allegiance to（宣誓效忠）；近义 vow、oath，语域更郑重。
collocations: make a pledge 作出承诺
pledge to do 保证做某事
pledge allegiance to 宣誓效忠
words.mnemonic: p+ledge（壁架）→立于壁架之上起誓→誓约

words.definition: adj. 名义上的；象征性的

examples.en: He is the nominal head of the company, but his son makes all the decisions.
examples.zh: 他只是公司的名义首脑，一切决策都由儿子拍板。

examples.en: Members pay only a nominal fee for the annual subscription.
examples.zh: 会员每年只需缴纳象征性的会费。

words.usage: nominal head（挂名首脑）实权在他处；a nominal fee（象征性收费）；经济学 in nominal terms（按名义值，与 real 对）。同根 nominate、nomination。
collocations: the nominal head 名义上的首脑
a nominal fee 象征性收费
in nominal terms 按名义价值
words.mnemonic: nomin（名）+al→徒有其名→名义上的

examples.en: The base was hit by a ballistic missile.
examples.zh: 基地遭到一枚弹道导弹袭击。

examples.en: Fans threw missiles onto the pitch.
examples.zh: 球迷向球场投掷杂物。

words.usage: ballistic/cruise missile（弹道/巡航导弹）新闻高频；missile attack/strike（导弹袭击）；miss（错过）+ ile → 飞向目标之物；英美音差大（美 ˈmɪsl 两音节）。
words.mnemonic: miss(送)+ile → 送向目标 → 导弹

words.definition: v. 挤，榨；挤入；勒索 n. 挤压；拮据

examples.en: She squeezed the juice from an orange.
examples.zh: 她把橙子榨成汁。

examples.en: We managed to squeeze into the crowded lift.
examples.zh: 我们勉强挤进拥挤的电梯。

words.usage: squeeze in/into（挤进）；squeeze out（榨出；排挤）；financial squeeze（财政拮据）新闻高频；squeeze toothpaste 挤牙膏；过去式 squeezed。
collocations: put the squeeze on 施压
words.mnemonic: sq-ueeze 用力挤一挤

words.definition: adj. 停滞的，不流动的；不景气的

examples.en: Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes.
examples.zh: 死水滋生蚊虫。

examples.en: Wages have remained stagnant for a decade.
examples.zh: 十年来工资一直原地踏步。

words.usage: stagnant water/economy/wages（死水/停滞经济/原地踏步的工资）高频；stagnation n. 停滞（economic stagnation 经济停滞）；stagnate v.；stan（站）→ 站着不动。

confusables.note: stagger 蹒跚·使震惊，stag- 同头

words.mnemonic: stan（站）+ant → 站着不动 → 停滞

examples.en: Growth hormone affects height and metabolism.
examples.zh: 生长激素影响身高和新陈代谢。

examples.en: Teenagers are ruled by hormones.
examples.zh: 青少年被荷尔蒙支配。

words.usage: growth/sex hormone（生长/性激素）医学高频；hormonal adj. 激素的（hormonal changes 激素变化）；口语「荷尔蒙」直接音译使用。
words.mnemonic: hormone 荷尔蒙音译词

examples.en: There is a growing consensus that climate action is urgent.
examples.zh: 人们越来越一致认为气候行动刻不容缓。

examples.en: After hours of debate, the committee reached a consensus.
examples.zh: 辩论数小时后，委员会达成共识。

words.usage: reach/arrive at a consensus（达成共识）高频；a consensus on/about（关于…的共识）；con（共）+ sens（感觉）；不可数或加不定冠词；科学语境 the scientific consensus。

confusables.note: census 人口普查，-sensus 形近！

collocations: reach a consensus 达成共识
words.mnemonic: con(共)+sens(感)→ 共同感受 → 共识

examples.en: They were charged with conspiracy to commit fraud.
examples.zh: 他们被控合谋诈骗。

examples.en: Conspiracy theories spread quickly online.
examples.zh: 阴谋论在网上迅速传播。

words.usage: conspiracy theory（阴谋论）高频；a conspiracy of silence（保持缄默的默契）；conspire v. 密谋（conspire against）；spir（呼吸）→ 同谋一气。

confusables.note: inspiration 灵感，-spiration 同根形近

collocations: uncover a conspiracy 揭穿阴谋
words.mnemonic: con(共)+spire(呼吸)→ 同气连枝密谋

examples.en: The company was accused of withholding vital information.
examples.zh: 这家公司被指隐瞒关键信息。

examples.en: She couldn't withhold her laughter.
examples.zh: 她忍不住笑出声。

words.usage: withhold information/payment（隐瞒信息/扣发款项）法律高频；withhold from（不告知；克制不做）；不规则动词 withhold-withheld-withheld；with（回）+ hold（持）。
words.mnemonic: with(回)+hold(持)→ 持而不发 → 扣留

words.definition: n. 垃圾，废弃物；一窝（仔） v. 乱扔垃圾

examples.en: Please don't litter in the park.
examples.zh: 请不要在公园乱扔垃圾。

examples.en: The cat gave birth to a litter of five kittens.
examples.zh: 母猫生了一窝五只小猫。

words.usage: drop litter（乱扔垃圾）、litter bin（垃圾桶）高频；a litter of（一窝）；litter tray（猫砂盆）；litterbug 乱扔垃圾者；与 rubbish（垃圾总称）、garbage（美）辨析。
collocations: a litter of kittens 一窝小猫
words.mnemonic: litter 垃圾别乱丢

words.definition: n. 同意，许可 v. 同意，准许

examples.en: Medical treatment requires the patient's informed consent.
examples.zh: 医疗需患者知情同意。

examples.en: Her parents consented to the marriage.
examples.zh: 她父母同意了这桩婚事。

words.usage: with/by common consent（经一致同意）高频；consent form（知情同意书）；consent to sth/doing（同意…）；con（共）+ sent（感觉）→ 情感相通 → 允许。

confusables.note: content 内容·满足，-tent 形近

words.mnemonic: con(共)+sent(情)→ 情感一致 → 允许
